pipeline.name: daily-seo-quickwins
pipeline.description: Daily SEO quick wins — find near-page-1 articles and optimize them

parent.title: [{{date}}] SEO quick wins
description: Orchestrate today's SEO optimization of existing articles.

1. When SEO Expert finishes the optimization brief: **review the brief** — verify the selected articles are genuine quick-win candidates (position 8-20, meaningful impressions). If the brief is solid, unblock the Copywriter task (set it to `todo`). If not, comment with feedback and ask SEO Expert to revise.

2. When Copywriter finishes optimizations + opens PR: **editorial quality gate** — review the changes match the brief, content reads naturally (no keyword stuffing), internal links are contextual. If good, unblock the Founding Engineer task. If changes needed, comment and ask Copywriter to fix.
3. When Founding Engineer merges: verify deploy at superdots.sh, then unblock IndexNow submit task.
4. When IndexNow confirms: close this parent task.
- Title tags: max 60 chars, target keyword front-loaded
- Meta descriptions: max 155 chars, include a compelling CTA
- No keyword stuffing — changes must read naturally
- Internal links must be contextual (in-sentence), never a list at the bottom

- **NEVER change pubDate** on existing articles — pubDate is the original publication date and must not be modified. Add or update `updatedDate: "{{date}}"` in frontmatter instead. Changing pubDate is a SEO penalty risk (date manipulation signal) and misleads readers.

## Step 2 — Select articles using these criteria (ALL must be true)

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Apply SEO optimizations to selected articles
description: Apply the optimization brief from the SEO Expert to each selected article.
Read the optimization brief in task [{{find_opportunities.identifier}}](/issues/{{find_opportunities.identifier}}) comments.
## Step 3 — Apply ALL optimizations from the brief
1. **Title tag**: update `title` field in frontmatter (this becomes the HTML <title>)
3. **Content improvements**: add/rewrite sections as specified in brief
4. **FAQ improvements**: add new questions, rewrite existing ones as specified
5. **Internal links TO this article**: edit the OTHER article files to add links pointing here
6. **Internal links FROM this article**: add contextual in-sentence links to related articles
- [ ] Title is ≤60 characters and target keyword appears in first half
- [ ] Description is ≤155 characters with a clear CTA
- [ ] All internal links are in-sentence (not a list at the bottom)
- [ ] Content reads naturally — no keyword stuffing
- [ ] `pubDate` is UNCHANGED (NEVER modify pubDate on existing articles)
- [ ] frontmatter fields are valid (department, useCase, tags all present)
git commit -m "fix: SEO optimize <slug> — target: <primary keyword>
--body "SEO optimization based on GSC/Bing data analysis."
One PR per article. If the brief covers 2 articles, create 2 separate branches and 2 PRs.
1. Post PR URL(s) as a comment on this task
3. @mention **@Content Manager**: "Optimization PR(s) ready for editorial review: <PR URLs>"
Content Manager approval of brief from [{{find_opportunities.identifier}}](/issues/{{find_opportunities.identifier}}).

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Editorial quality gate — review optimization PRs
description: Review the optimization PRs to ensure quality standards before merge.
## Step 1 — Read the brief and the PR
## Step 2 — Review checklist for each PR
- [ ] Title tag: ≤60 chars, target keyword front-loaded, compelling
- [ ] Meta description: ≤155 chars, includes CTA, not truncated
- [ ] Content changes match the brief's recommendations
- [ ] No keyword stuffing — text reads naturally, same voice as original
- [ ] Internal links are contextual (in-sentence), anchor text is descriptive
- [ ] pubDate is UNCHANGED (reject PR immediately if pubDate was modified)
- [ ] No unrelated changes (only files from the brief)
**If APPROVED**: Set this task to `done`, @mention **@Founding Engineer**: "SEO optimization PR #XX approved — please review, merge, and submit to IndexNow"

**If CHANGES NEEDED**: Comment on this task with specific feedback (what to fix and why). @mention **@Copywriter** to apply fixes. Do NOT unblock the merge step until fixes are applied. Keep this task `in_progress` until resolved.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Merge SEO optimization PRs
description: Merge the Content Manager-approved optimization PRs.
Check comments on [{{apply_optimizations.identifier}}](/issues/{{apply_optimizations.identifier}}) for PR URLs.
- Verify no merge conflicts with main
This enables GitHub auto-merge — the PR merges automatically when CI passes (~1 min).
Alternative (waits in-session): `bash scripts/merge-when-green.sh <number>` (polls CI, merges when green, max 5 min).
**NEVER exit the heartbeat with a PR pending merge.** CI takes ~1 minute. Either use --auto or wait.
Wait ~90 seconds, then verify at https://superdots.sh/blog/<slug>:
- New title tag visible in page source
- New meta description visible in page source
1. Comment with merged PR URL(s) + deploy confirmation
3. @mention **@Content Manager**: "PRs merged and deployed — ready for IndexNow submit"
